product.description: Monoprice™Monoprice USB‑C to DisplayPort Cable [8K@60Hz, 4K@144Hz, 2K@240Hz]8K@60Hz, 4K@144Hz/120Hz, 2K@240Hz, HDR10+, Nylon‑braided and Aluminum housing, wide compatibility with all USB‑C devices, mirror & extended mode displaysIntroducing the Monoprice 8K@60Hz, 4K@144Hz/120Hz, 2K@240Hz USB‑C to DisplayPort Cable, 6ft, a game‑changing accessory that brings your viewing and gaming experience to a whole new level. Whether you're a sports enthusiast, a movie lover, or a gaming aficionado, this cable is designed to deliver stunning visuals with exceptional performance.Immerse yourself in the world of high‑resolution entertainment with this cable's impressive capabilities. It supports a wide range of resolutions and refresh rates, including 8K@60Hz, 4K@144Hz/120Hz, and 2K@240Hz. Enjoy crystal‑clear images and ultra‑smooth motion, ensuring you never miss a detail or experience any lag during your viewing or gaming sessions.One of the standout features of this cable is its support for HDR10+. With this technology, you can enjoy enhanced brightness, remarkable contrast, and a broader color spectrum. The result is vivid and lifelike visuals that make everything on your screen come alive. From the deepest shadows to the brightest highlights, HDR10+ ensures that every scene is rich in detail and depth.Crafted with durability and reliability in mind, the Monoprice USB‑C to DisplayPort Cable is built to last. The premium nylon‑braided construction not only provides flexibility, but also offers superior strength, protecting the cable from daily wear and tear. Additionally, the aluminum housing enhances heat dissipation, preventing overheating and ensuring optimal performance even during extended use.Versatility is another key feature of this cable. It is compatible with a wide range of devices, including MacOS, Windows, and Android laptops, tablets, and phones. Whether you have a USB4, USB3, or USB2 port, this cable will seamlessly connect your USB‑C device to a DisplayPort‑enabled monitor or display. Enjoy the convenience of connecting and expanding your screen real estate effortlessly.The Monoprice USB‑C to DisplayPort Cable supports both mirror and extended display modes. Mirror mode allows you to duplicate your screen, making it ideal for presentations or sharing content with others. Extended display mode, on the other hand, enables you to extend your desktop across multiple screens, providing you with more workspace and productivity.In conclusion, the Monoprice 8K@60Hz, 4K@144Hz/120Hz, 2K@240Hz USB‑C to DisplayPort Cable, 6ft is the ultimate solution for those seeking high‑performance connectivity between their USB‑C devices and DisplayPort‑enabled monitors or displays.
